lines.1: 「Why do we have to throw that woman a welcome party?」
lines.3: 「I'm nice to beautiful women. I'm extra nice to incredibly beautiful women. Therefore, I'm extra nice to Otome.」
lines.4: 「Then you should be even nicer to me.」
lines.5: 「You're just a sea creature. Go blow some bubbles.」
lines.6: 「I don't wanna hear that from a shark! And crabs live in streams too, you know!」
lines.7: 「What?! A shark obviously beats a crab!」
lines.8: 「Quit that pointless argument. You're embarrassing yourselves.」
lines.9: 「But he dragged me! He made me experience waking up from friction burns!」
lines.10: 「Here. Take this giant piece of bubble gum and shut up.」
lines.13: 「Good. We've stocked up on prepared food.」
lines.14: 「Otome would get mad if we brought alcohol, even as a joke. Oolong tea will do for drinks.」
lines.15: 「You don't have to tiptoe around a woman like that, Subaru.」
lines.16: 「You think I'm happy about it? Leo's house is our hangout. But the decision's already made, so what can we do?」
lines.18: 「Besides, I wanna see what happens if Leo and Otome--two people with no romantic feelings at all--end up together.」
lines.19: 「Leo? With a woman who knocks people out with palm strikes? No way.」
lines.20: 「Otome seems big on repaying favors. Think of this as putting her in our debt.」
lines.21: 「I guess that works. As long as I get to eat my fill.」
lines.23: 「Oh! Chewing gum made my stomach roar for real food!」
lines.24: 「Slave to your instincts, aren't you? Come on, let's head back.」
